title: Partial refunds with idempotency
requirement:
Merchants need to issue partial refunds on captured payments.

- Extend refunds.service.issue_refund to accept an optional amount (minor units) and an optional idempotency_key. When amount is omitted, refund the full remaining amount.
- The total of all refunds for a payment must never exceed the captured amount. Non-positive amounts are rejected.
- Retrying a request with the same idempotency_key for the same payment must return the original refund and must not create a second one.
- Payment status becomes partially_refunded after a partial refund and refunded once the full amount has been refunded.
- The refund API handler must accept optional amount and idempotency_key fields.
- Existing behaviour (ownership check, captured-only refunds) must be preserved.

title: Reservation expiry (TTL)
requirement:
Abandoned checkouts hold stock forever. Reservations must expire.

- Each store has a configurable reservation TTL in seconds, default 900 (15 minutes), set via InventoryStore(ttl_seconds=...).
- A reservation is expired when now - created_at >= ttl_seconds.
- inventory.catalog.available(store, sku, now=None) must ignore expired reservations when now is given; without now it behaves as today.
- inventory.reservations.commit(store, reservation_id, now=None) must raise ReservationError for an expired reservation when now is given.
- reserve() must ignore expired reservations when checking stock (it already receives now).
- Add inventory.reservations.expire_stale(store, now) that removes expired reservations and returns how many were removed.

title: Refund listing endpoint (live mode only)
requirement: Add an API handler handle_list_refunds(conn, request) in api/handlers.py that returns all refunds for a payment as {"status": 200, "body": {"refunds": [{"refund_id", "amount", "created_at"}], "total_refunded": int}}. Only the merchant that owns the payment may list its refunds (403 otherwise). Unknown payments return 404.
